book.name: Jon
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Jon kaavu

content: Yesu halindin-ame lawii-having yi le
+ o 7:1 Jon 5:18*Lung laa tonde hil Yuda lawiingin nambe lanyiis Yesu be jimb, om nimbaya nambe me-gatup hôôk Yudia le, tombe la monatup hôôk Galili.
+ o 7:2 Lev 23:34*Tonde hil Yuda-te busin bop sen danêêl nambe busin numang-atêêto
ngaaho lak,
om Yesu-te halindin lanêêl vu yi nambe, “Onggavuuh taakuu-jo de gana Yudia in gate hil lanji kul sen onawiing-anjôôto le.
Omaaho ti wiingin nambe biing banye jak ond me-nawiing va hôôk vunin e, om onawiing vaa-ja ond gana taato hong langaah-ambe hil lanji.”
+ o 7:5 Mat 13:55; Sin 1:14*Yik Yesu halindin-ame lawii-having yi having e ondeey lanêêl nambêênju.
+ o 7:6 Jon 2:4; 7:30*Tombe Yesu nêêl vu sil nambe, “Sate busin naahen, nganjo busin pin-anjo ham oote,
+ o 7:7 Jon 15:18*in hil pin vu voon-ame lalohvu nambe nind baya in ham lôôt e. Nganjo sak sil anind baya in sa lôôt, in sa naanêêl sil langaah nambe dawiing va nipaya.
Om ham oo ana balu-angge busin bop-anju, nganjo sak same le ana aangge busin bop-anju gaving e, in sate busin naahen.”
Nêêl vakasin-anjo vu sil atonde nando Galili.
Yesu la yi busin bop numang-ate vu Yelusalem
Tombe Yesu halindin lala lalup in lanji busin bop vu Yelusalem, tonde sim Yesu yoo motaamuyin sil-ambe la valup, le me-taato yi langaah e, nganjo yoo la kaatokin.
+ o 7:11 Jon 11:56*Tonde hil Yuda davu salo yi hôôk busin bop-anju be dalingin nambe, “Omaahôô-juuto nando tana?”
Tombe hil davu pataalang ak yi lôôt, om vaalu danêêl nambe, “Yi omaaho nivasa,” de vaalu danêêl nambe, “Malis, navu tatuhin hil.”
+ o 7:13 Jon 9:22; 12:42; 19:38; 20:19*Lemu ti me-nêêl vakasin-anju lak yi laam langaah e, in layêênin silate hil Yuda vaalu.
Layi busin bop-anju be la lavuun lôôt, tonde Yesu valup-ambe lukala Anutu-te dumb bop alo be nêêl tanasin vu hil.
+ o 7:15 Mat 13:54; Luk 2:47*Tombe hil Yuda lavindis nambe, “Omaahôô-ju lak tanasin ani vu tana? Omaaho ti me-taahu yi le.”
+ o 7:16 Jon 12:49; 14:10*Le Yesu nêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Tanasin sen saanêêl vu ham-anja ond same soo sate va le, malis, nganjo omaaho sen wiing sa laam-ato yite vakasin.
Om omaaho ti wiingin nambe biing va nohvu Anutu ka ond le jak tanasin sen saanêêl-anjo dangga ni naambe laam vu Anutu keen, me, soo aanêêl lohvu sa kangg ond yik le jak ni.

+ o 7:18 Jon 5:41; 8:50*De omaaho ti yoo nanêêl vakasin nalohvu ka ond yoo wiingin gako haale jak. Lemu omaaho ti wiingin nambe gako omaaho sen wiing yi laam-ato haale jak, ond mem omaahôô-ju yoo monanêêl vakasin osin keen, de tatuhin ti me-neep vu yi le.
+ o 7:19 Sin 7:53; Lom 2:21-24*Mose vu tanasin nomaayuuh vu ham bôôy-ato, lemu ham-anja ti me-navu samu tanasin-anju le. Nambe tana sen ham nawiingin nambe anyiis sa be saanggimb?”
+ o 7:20 Jon 8:48,52; 10:20*Tombe hil-anju lanêêl laah vu yi nambe, “Mamu ti hôôvu hong. Lati wiingin nambe nyiis hong-ambe ganggimb?”
+ o 7:21 Jon 5:16*Le Yesu nêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Saawiing kul bopaata timuu-jo be ham pin avindis in.

+ o 7:22 Lev 12:3; Jen 17:9-13*De Mose nêêl nambe, ‘Ham galaah ham anim naavi,’ le gambum-anja Mose me-nêêl e, manyinja yoo vu hamate himbop-aso bôôy, de ham nalaah unoopasiv anind naavi hôôk busin sawaasin

+ o 7:23 Jon 5:8-10,16*Ond ham nalaah unoopasiv anind naavi hôôk busin sawaasin in nambe ham-ame kalêêh Mose-te tanasin e, tonde saawiing omaaho ti ninaavi nivasa lak hôôk busin sawaasin, le nambe vaati sen ham ahem kalin vu sa?
+ o 7:24 Lev 19:15; Ais 11:3-4; Jon 8:15*Ham-ame naanêêl hil danjeen e, nganjo ham oo anjak vakasin danggakook ani vêêl e mem ham naanêêl.”
Lakaas ak nambe Yesu omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato
+ o 7:25 Jon 5:18*Tombe hil Yelusalem vaalu dalingin sil nambe, “Omaaho sen lawiingin nambe lanyiis-ato ond yii-ju?
Om angge, nanêêl vakasin naale langaah, lemu me-lanêêl vakasin ti lak yi le, in mak yêêv-aso lalak ni lung la nambe yi omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato mava?
+ o 7:27 Jon 7:41; 9:29*Lemu omaahôô-ju yalak yite danggakook ani nambe vu voon, nganjo omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato naam ond yiiy pin e doosin yite dangga.”

+ o 7:28-29 Mat 11:27; Jon 8:55*Om Yesu nêêl tanasin hôôk Anutu-te dumb bop alo be nêêl osin niwêêk nambe, “Ke, ham alak sa ningg-ambe ham alak sate danggakook ani keen a? Lemu same yoo alaam lohvu sa kangg e, omaaho sen wiing sa laam-ato yi omaaho vakasin keen, lemu ham doosin yi.
De sak, ond sa lak ni, in sa nando having yi be wiing sa be sa laam-anjo.”
+ o 7:30 Jon 7:44; 8:20; 13:1*Tombe hil lawiingin nambe lanôôh yi lemu yite busin naahen, om omaaho ti me-lôôh nama lak yi le, malis.

+ o 7:31 Jon 2:23; 8:30; 10:42; 11:45; 12:11,42*Tonde hil ngeeyaata lawii-having yi be lanêêl nambe, “De omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato naam ond mak le biing taahu taahu osin niwêêk-ambe savok omaahôô-jute kul aniwêêk-ato na, me? Om mak yii-ju.”
Lawiing ahevaavu heey lala in nambe lanôôh Yesu
Tombe hil Palisai lango de hil davu pataalang vakasin-anju lak Yesu, om kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin hil Palisai lawiing silate ahevaavu-so heey lala in nambe lanôôh Yesu.
+ o 7:33 Jon 13:33*Tombe Yesu nêêl nambe, “Yik sale mando gaving ham pasivdaka vêêl e mem sa naah vu omaaho sen wiing sa laam-ato,
+ o 7:34 Jon 8:21; 13:36; 17:24*de ham e mosalo sa, le ham-ame le naatovu sa le. De taaku sen sana mandôô-to ond ham-ame alohvu nambe ham ana le.”
Tombe hil Yuda yoo lakaas-ambe lanêêl vu sil nambe, “In navu na tana de yame naatovu yi le? Mak navu na vu yate hil vaalu sen dando Glik-ate taakuu-to in motaahu hil Glik-anju?
De sen nêêl nambe, ‘Ham oo le mosalo sa, lemu ham-ame le naatovu sa le,’ de nêêl ango nambe, ‘Taaku sen sana mandôô-to ond ham-ame alohvu nambe ham ana le,’ ond vakasin-anjo danggakook nambe vaati?”
Bel metumin-ate

+ o 7:37 Lev 23:36; Ais 55:1; Jon 4:10,14*Busin bop numang-ate busin navu jung na, tonde busin ti lakaneep ak ahus ond silate busin bopaata lôôt, tombe hôôk busin-anju Yesu naale be nêêl bopaata nambe, “Omaaho ti nambe lo bambôôv in bel ond yoo naam vu sa be naanum,
+ o 7:38 Ais 58:11; Sek 14:8*lohvu Anutu-te vakasin neep hôôk kaapiya nambe, ‘Omaaho ti nambe lopayo naam timu vu sa, ond bel metumin-ate ngeeyaata le bêêl gato vu lopayo be na.’”

+ o 7:39 Jon 16:7; 20:22; Sin 2:4*Vakasin-anjo Yesu nêêl lak Vavi Vaambuung sen navu bu naam vu hil sen londpayo la timu vu yii-to, le busin naahen om Vavi Vaambuung-ame lukalaam e, in Yesu me-kandi lak-ambe haale tu bop ak e de naahen.
Hil alondpayo me-lavuh ti le
+ o 7:40 Diu 18:15; Jon 6:14; Sin 3:22*Hil ngeeyaata lango vakasin-anju, tombe vaalu lanêêl nambe, “Keen, omaahôô-ju yi Anutu-te omaaho sen yiiy nanggin yii-to.”

+ o 7:41 Jon 4:29; 1:46; 7:52*De hil vaalu lanêêl nambe, “Manyinju omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato.” Tonde vaalu lanêêl nambe, “Ôôye, omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato me-le naam vu Galili le.

+ o 7:42 2Sml 7:12; Saam 89:3-4; Mai 5:2; Mat 2:5-6*Vakasin sen neep hôôk Anutu-te kaapiyaa-to nêêl lung la nambe, ‘Omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato yite danggakook neep vu Devit, tombe le naam vu bayêên Betlehem sen Devit nando bôôy-ato.’”
+ o 7:43 Jon 9:16*Om hil laasuh sil la yuuh in Yesu,
+ o 7:44 Jon 7:30*tombe sil vaalu lawiingin nambe lanôôh Yesu, lemu omaaho ti me-lôôh nama lak yi le.
Himbop-aso me-lawii-having Yesu le

+ o 7:45 Jon 7:32*Tonde ahevaavu-so lalaah lalu-vu kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin hil Palisai, tombe lanêêl vu ahevaavu-so nambe, “Nambe vaati sen ham-ame hako omaahôô-ju laam e?”
+ o 7:46 Mak 1:22*Le ahevaavu-so lanêêl laah nambe, “Omaaho ti me-nakaas nambe omaahôô-ju bôôy e.”
Tombe Palisai-so lanêêl laah vu sil nambe, “Om peey e tatuhin ham having a?
+ o 7:48 Jon 12:42*Tonde hey yêêv-aso osin Palisai ond ham ahe nambe hey ti tana wii-having yi? Malis.
Lemu hil mali-malis sen dango Yesu lavaa-ju ond sil doosin Mose-te tanasin, om Anutu le biing-ambe sil lana mend nama.”
+ o 7:50 Jon 3:1-2; 19:39*Tombe sil ti Nikotemus sen la vu Yesu bôôy-ato ond nêêl vu sil nambe,
+ o 7:51 Diu 1:16*“Yame gango omaaho ti-te vakasin osin yame anjak va sen wiing-ato dangga ni le, de yaambu nivaane vu yi malis amu, ond mak lohvu yate tanasin nêêl a?”

+ o 7:52 Jon 7:41-42*Tombe lanêêl laah vu Nikotemus nambe, “Mak hong-anja hong vu Galili having a? Onaasevin Anutu-te vakasin sen neep hôôk kaapiyaa-to nivasa le mem gale ganjak ni naambe hil sen danêêl Anutu-te vakasin langaah-ato ti me-le naam vu Galili le.”
[Tonde sil pin lavuuh taale be lalaah sil ambaand ti ti.]

footnotes.text: Hil Yuda dayi silate busin bop sen danêêl nambe busin numang-atêêto ond sil dahaav numang-ambe dando hôôk lohvu sonda ti lôôt, in kand navu mopaatôôv sen silate himbop-aso dando hôôk taaku lumbalaamb bôôy-ato be davu taamuyin, tonde yik sil dapêêlis la vu Anutu having in silate vanôôn kul moos anye.

Hil Yuda-te tanasin bôôy neep nambe vêêh ti gako noow moow ti gato be yite busin naatu namaavaalu be vindak yaal jak ond sil galaah unoopasiv aninaavi. Tombe tanasin-anjo ond neep niwêêk om sil-ame lalohvu in nambe sil kalêêh e, om naambe busin naatu vindak yaal dôôk busin sawaasin ti, ond yik dalaah ninaavi de me-dayêênin busin sawaasin e. Ondeey Yesu nêêl sil in dapuvu tanasin tii-jo hôôn de davu kalêêh hôôk busin sawaasin, le nambe vaati om sil ahend kalin vu yi in nawiing omaaho ti nivasa lak hôôk busin sawaasin.
